mapper.sql: select csp.id, csp.student_id, csp.user_id, csp.relation_type, csp.is_primary, csp.notify_enabled, csp.create_by, csp.create_time, csp.update_by, csp.update_time, cu.phone, cu.name as user_name, cu.open_id from cf_student_parent csp inner join cf_user cu on csp.user_id = cu.id and cu.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: where csp.student_id = #{studentId} order by csp.is_primary desc, csp.id asc

select csp.id, csp.student_id, csp.user_id, csp.relation_type, csp.is_primary, csp.notify_enabled, cs.name as student_name, cu.phone, cu.name as user_name from cf_student_parent csp inner join cf_student cs on csp.student_id = cs.id inner join cf_user cu on csp.user_id = cu.id and cu.del_flag = '0' where csp.user_id = #{userId} order by csp.is_primary desc, csp.id asc

SELECT cs.name AS studentName, cu.open_id AS openId, sd.dept_name AS school FROM cf_student cs INNER JOIN cf_student_parent csp ON cs.id = csp.student_id AND csp.notify_enabled = 1 INNER JOIN cf_user cu ON csp.user_id = cu.id AND cu.del_flag = '0' AND cu.open_id IS NOT NULL AND cu.open_id != '' LEFT JOIN sys_dept sd ON cs.dept_id = sd.dept_id WHERE cs.id = #{studentId}
